_comment: THE QUARANTINE LIST, read by tests/_quarantine.py on every pytest run of this repository and reported against by
scripts/quarantine_time_caps.py. A listed test keeps running and reports, but does not block, through its deadline
(UTC); from the next day it blocks again. No test is skipped and none is deleted.
Each entry: test (a pytest node id; without a parameter id it covers every parameter), reason, deadline
(YYYY-MM-DD), owner. A missing field, another field, a malformed date or a test listed twice stops the run.
The first entries, 2026-10-25: the two time caps the owner named in Nachtrag 7 of card
CLOUD-640-BESCHLEUNIGER-AUF-MAIN-01, as long as their fixes on other branches are open. The fix of the cap of
tests/test_c12_1_nicht_anwendbar_vor_dem_tag.py landed on main on 2026-10-31 (68d3f020, timeout=900), and its
four entries left the list; tests/test_quarantine.py holds that every entry names the cap the tree carries.

quarantine.reason: The cost at the limit is asserted against achsen x GRENZE_S (1.0 s) x the machine factor (`assert k <= latte`). The owner named the cost curve of renewal_work under 3.14 on 2026-10-25 (Nachtrag 7 of card CLOUD-640-BESCHLEUNIGER-AUF-MAIN-01); another session fixes it on branches of its own, and the entry stays while that fix is open.
